title: 第七百九十六章 天降神蚌 慈心破障第七百九十五章 一爪骇世 万法归寂
content_zh:
凌空悬浮的六翼蝶妖依托花百漾的异法命格凝形存续。
这一招“终极异蝶术”，本就是透支神魂体魄、耗尽浑厚内力换来的禁绝杀招！
一旦使出，神鬼难挡、无法可破！
漫天爪意缓缓下沉，六翼蝶妖身形渐近！
那双漆黑锋利的无形巨爪，终于死死攫住二人胸腔之内蓬勃跳动的心脏！
死死扣锁、紧紧攥握！
骤然的脏腑剧痛、窒息感瞬间席卷全身！
虫小蝶、沈惊鸿身躯剧烈震颤，浑身经脉撕痛抽搐！
呼吸彻底滞涩，胸口如被山岳碾压。
连一丝气息都难以吞吐！
剧痛、窒息、禁锢、绝望层层叠加！
丝丝缕缕的猩红血丝，从二人嘴角、鼻孔缓缓溢出。
顺着下颌缓缓滴落，染红衣襟，触目惊心！
就在二人命悬一线、即将殒命的刹那！
漆黑幽深的寺外甬道之中，骤然数道赤红光影破空激射！
“嗖嗖嗖——！”
数声锐响撕裂死寂夜空！
数枚血色暗器携摧枯拉朽的迅猛劲风，划出灼热赤红的破空轨迹。
直扑花百漾面门。
速度快到肉眼难辨、劲势霸道绝伦！

花百漾面色沉静无波，丝毫不显慌乱。
他左脚猛然向前重重一踏！
轰隆气劲落地，地面微微震颤！
一圈浑厚磅礴的真气气旋自地面轰然涌出！
层层叠叠、盘旋流转。
罡风呼啸、气劲翻涌，稳稳挡在身前！
数枚血色暗器狠狠撞入真气气旋之中！
咻咻锐鸣不绝于耳！
暗器瞬间被气旋扭转轨迹，骤然四散纷飞。
朝着荒寺四面八方的黑暗角落激射而去！
“噗噗噗！”
数声闷响接连响起，尽数没入沉沉黑暗！
唯独有一枚血色暗器力道最沉、速度最快。
破空辗转，直直落至魔鱼长老身侧那株粗壮古槐之上！
“乒！”
硬物入木脆响刺耳，暗器深深钉入树干数寸之深！
下一瞬——
“嘭！”
content_en:
The six-winged butterfly demon suspended in the sky relied on Hua Baiyang's magical destiny to condense into existence.
This move, the "Ultimate Alien Butterfly Technique", is a forbidden killing move obtained by overdrawing one's soul and body and exhausting one's powerful internal energy!
Once used, it will be unstoppable and unstoppable!
The claws in the sky slowly sink, and the figure of the six-winged butterfly demon gradually approaches!
Those black and sharp invisible giant claws finally grabbed hold of the beating hearts in their chests!
Lock it tightly, hold it tightly!
Sudden severe pain in the internal organs and a sense of suffocation swept through the whole body instantly!
Chong Xiaodie and Shen Jinghong's bodies were shaking violently, and their meridians were twitching with pain!
His breathing was completely sluggish, and his chest felt like it was being crushed by a mountain.
It’s hard to even take a breath!
Severe pain, suffocation, confinement, and despair piled on top of each other!
Threads of scarlet blood slowly overflowed from the corners of their mouths and nostrils.
It slowly dripped down the chin and dyed the skirt of the clothes red, which was shocking!
At the moment when their lives were hanging by a thread and they were about to die!
In the dark and deep corridor outside the temple, several red lights and shadows suddenly shot through the air!
"Whoosh whoosh-!"
Several sharp sounds tore through the dead night sky!
Several bloody hidden weapons, carrying the devastating and swift wind, drew scorching red trajectories through the sky.
Go straight to Hua Baiyang's door.
The speed is so fast that it is difficult to tell with the naked eye, and the power is so domineering!
Hua Baiyang's expression was calm and calm, showing no signs of panic.
He suddenly stepped forward with his left foot!
Landing with a bang, the ground shook slightly!
A thick and majestic cyclone of true energy burst out from the ground!
Layers upon layers, swirling and flowing.
The strong wind is howling and the energy is surging, standing firmly in front of you!
Several bloody hidden weapons slammed into the true energy cyclone!
The ringing sound is endless!
The hidden weapon was instantly reversed by the cyclone and suddenly scattered in all directions.
Shooting towards the dark corners in all directions of the deserted temple!
"Puff puff puff!"
Several muffled sounds sounded one after another, and they were all submerged into the darkness!
There is only one bloody hidden weapon that is the heaviest and fastest.
It turned around through the air and landed directly on the sturdy ancient locust tree beside Elder Demon Fish!
"Ping!"
Hard objects penetrated into the wood with a crisp and ear-piercing sound, and hidden weapons were nailed several inches deep into the trunk of the tree!
The next moment——
"Bang!"
